description: Frozen P34 data-construction build. P34.4 must label, Cmax and Ki the fresh held-out set with exactly these files; tests/test_p34_2_frozen_build.py pins their sha256. No held-out or fresh drug was read.

frozen_files.what: pre-specified liability term map, table rules and placebo-subtracted margin (P33.2, amendments A1-A7)
openFDA adverse-reaction table parser applying liability_rules.json
openFDA bulk label index read by v2_liabilities and v2_cmax
therapeutic total Cmax: label/PubMed candidate snippets, verbatim-snippet build, Cmax,u via plasma fu
ChEMBL plasma fu build (inputs/plasma_fu.json), priority-1 fu source
merge rule for additional measured plasma fu sources on top of v2_pk (PR #52)
DrugCentral (Lombardo 2018) plasma fu fetch with exact-title match (PR #52)
InChI cross-check that drops any DrugCentral fu match whose structure differs (PR #52)
human Ki panel: ChEMBL filters, censored bounds, GtoPdb and PDSP merge, per-document mean then median (PR #51)

label_sources_for_fresh_set: openFDA (scripts/v2_liabilities.py), identical to the train labels

smpc_parser.decision: not used for the fresh set. The prereg allows SmPC tables only if frozen here; PR #49's parser was validated on 3 train drugs whose 12 labels were all negative (no positive control), and only 3 of 180 train drugs with an emc SmPC carried a placebo table. Fresh labels therefore come from the same openFDA-only procedure as the train labels.

not_freezable_by_hash: Cmax snippet curation is a judgement made per drug; P34.4 must follow the rules written in v2_cmax.py
live sources (openFDA, ChEMBL, GtoPdb, PDSP, DrugCentral) can change; P34.4 records retrieval dates
heldout: not touched; the v2 held-out stays burned and the fresh set does not exist yet (P34.4)
